title: PicoDome Sandbox Result
description: JSON Schema for PicoDome L3 sandbox output (SandboxResult)

command.description: The command that was executed in the sandbox

events.description: List of sandbox events observed during execution

exit_code.description: Exit code of the sandboxed process

policy_name.description: Name of the sandbox policy used

duration_ms.description: Duration of the sandbox execution in milliseconds (omitted in deterministic mode)

run_id.description: Unique run identifier (empty string in deterministic mode, UUID4 otherwise)

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the run (empty string in deterministic mode)

stdout.description: Captured stdout from the sandboxed process

stderr.description: Captured stderr from the sandboxed process

operation.description: The operation that triggered the event

path.description: File path involved in the event

rule_id.description: ID of the policy rule that matched

timestamp_ms.description: Event timestamp in milliseconds (omitted in deterministic mode)
